name: Haunted Library OH 2024
information:
**This competition takes place on a Thursday afternoon**

Candy will be provided for all competitors and there will be a costume contest as well.

Due to the small size of this competition, all competitors will be expected to help judge/run while they are not competing.

This competition is organized by the Columbus Cubing Club - check out the [website](https://columbuscubingclub.weebly.com/) for information on meetings and future competitions!
